mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, which may be potentiated in patients with reduced renal function; donepezil is renally cleared and may accumulate if renal function declines.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent use; adjust donepezil dose if creatinine clearance declines significantly; ensure adequate hydration during tobramycin therapy.
